summary: Barclays PLC filed a Form 6-K on October 1, 2026, aggregating routine London Stock Exchange disclosures for its ongoing share buy-back programme announced July 29, 2026. The bank repurchased ordinary shares for cancellation through Citigroup Global Markets Limited across late August and September, paying a volume-weighted average of roughly 493-507 pence per share. Since programme inception, 68,066,215 shares were bought at a 507.3708p VWAP, leaving 13,441,073,778 ordinary shares outstanding. The filing also includes total voting rights updates and a block admission application. No board recommendation or premium applies; watch execution pace and any program expansion or suspension.
